preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
Each test case must have a number of vertices n between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of vertices saved for each test case.
